lyrics:
[Spoken Word]

The Kayfabe Money Trail, Nine-Eleven: follow the bets, not the press conference.

Tonight we read the paperwork around that Tuesday, card by card, and we never joke about the dead.

My bank phones me over a twenty-euro transfer. Someone bets against two airlines right before the attacks, and the Commission calls the money's origin of little practical significance.

Nine-Eleven Trillions: Follow The Kayfabe-Money! No neutrality, pure financial wrestling.

Rule Number One: Follow the Money. Nine-Eleven, a crime: detectives must identify perpetrators.

Detectives, meet: The Coincidence Engine: most extraordinary coincidence in history, if it was one.

Treasury's Ten Veils, go through ten veils before the real Source, thanks to the Treasury.

Behind the veils: The Privatized Towers, a ninety-nine-year lease signed for three point two billion.

The Fourteen Million Dollar Bridge: little own money, control of a multi-billion dollar empire.

Tiny stake: The Double-Trouble Policy, doubling the insurance, demanding two separate events to win.

The Secret Eighty Percent Kickback, initial equity refunded while maintaining total control.

Floors Ninety-Three To One Hundred: Marsh and McLennan in the exact impact zone, North Tower.

On those floors: Silver Stream E-Link, Marsh: first financial company with this paperless technology.

But VOID receipts: The Ten Million Dollar Anomalies, severe fiscal anomalies, unnecessary hardware sales.

The Upper West Side Safehouse, executive safe at home; IT staff investigating fraud perished.

Convar Data Recovery, an unexplained surge in transactions; now, no additional information.

The Forty-Minute Window, Deutsche Bank computers externally taken over; download and purge.

About the surge: The Absolute Shopping Binge: Americans shopping on Tuesday morning, dripping with irony.

Paul Bremer's NBC Pivot, Marsh's risk chief on NBC blaming Bin Laden before the dust settled.

But off camera: The Put Options: bets against United and American Airlines, thirty times normal volume.

Flip the bet: The Raytheon Call, six-fold increase in calls; cash in when the military deployed missiles.

Detectives abroad: The Global Manhunt, foreign finance ministers certain; probes fizzle out on US soil.

Stateside: The CBOE Shredder, FOIA researchers asked for the evidence; told the records were destroyed.

The Stratex Spike, Walker bought fifty-six thousand shares; FBI never interviewed him, no ties.

The Ritz-Carlton Meeting, Carlyle Group meets Bin Laden's brother in DC on September eleventh.

Buzzy Krongard's Brokerage, puts brokered by the former firm of the CIA's Executive Director.

The San Diego Cash-Out: a DOD staffer cashed out the day before; no agency ever investigated.

The SEC Investigation: those who had advanced knowledge didn't trade. So WHO had knowledge?

The Single Institutional Investor, ninety-five percent of puts; no conceivable ties: free pass.

To empty chairs: Academic Probability, three scientific papers: high probability of advanced knowledge.

The Nine-Eleven Commission Handwave: final word rejected the first rule, Follow the Money.

Twenty euros get a phone call from my bank; two point four million gets a Commission and a shredder.

Stay Fluffy, Folks!
lyrics2:
[Spoken Word]

The Kayfabe Money Trail, Nine-Eleven, part two: follow the Pentagon's missing trillions and see who never has to answer for them.

Confession: I'm no accountant, and tonight I read you thirty-two cards on the people paid to check the books.

My own bookkeeping is a shoebox of receipts. Lose one, and the taxman wants a meeting.

Lose two point three trillion in defense dollars, and somebody hands you a bigger budget.

Insiders, listen for Dov Zakheim, a firm called Ptech, and a Rumsfeld speech dated September tenth.

The giant eye: Ptech Enterprise Architecture, the person running it can foresee problems, or cause them.

The Next Generation Blueprint, JP Morgan sought software to stop rogue trading and failures.

The Keys to the Cyber Kingdom, Ptech pictured how agency vulnerabilities could be exploited.

Keys in hand: The FAA Basement Interoperability, Ptech looking for holes in hijacking emergency response.

But bloodhounds: Vulgar Betrayal, Wright and Vincent blocked from investigating the man financing Ptech.

Yassin al-Qadi, angel investor behind Ptech, later put on a US Treasury terrorist watch list.

Sarmand Limited, the investment firm backed by al-Qadi that got Ptech off the ground.

BMI Real Estate, shared office space with al-Qadi; run by Ptech's own Chief Scientist.

The Radical Chief Architect, quoted Bin Laden's mentor while mapping US military blueprints.

Courtesy first: The Pre-Raid Warning, Ptech was given two weeks advanced warning before the FBI raid.

Nothing to find: Tom Ridge's Rubber Stamp, Ptech in no way jeopardizes the security of the country.

The referee? Thomas Kean's Wallet, twenty-four million with BMI; the Commission never looked into Ptech.

Meanwhile, the eagle: Rumsfeld's Declaration, the adversary is closer to home: the Pentagon bureaucracy.

Under the rug: The Two Point Three Trillion Cushion, not accounted for in nineteen ninety-nine alone.

One man looked: The Whistleblower's Reward, Jim Minnery's director asked him: why do you care about this?

Up the ladder: Dov Zakheim's Ledger, tasked with missing money, drafted transformation papers instead.

SPC International, Zakheim's former company, provided advanced military electronics to DARPA.

Rebuilding America's Defenses, PNAC called for transformation, including biological warfare.

Circled: The New Pearl Harbor, a long transformation, absent some catastrophic and catalyzing event.

So, herd the deer: The Fear Integration, what registers on people is fear; fifty billion budget increase.

Wedge One Renovations, just moved back in; thirty-four bookkeepers and budget analysts killed.

The Unproduceable Report, Army unable to report, due to the loss of accountants in the attack.

Thomas White's Enron Playbook, largest accounting fraud in history, then Secretary of the Army.

Building Seven SEC Vault, evidence on Enron and others wiped out when the building collapsed.

The Eight Point Five Trillion Benchmark, Rumsfeld's war, successful at losing even more money.

Ask the mouse: The Standard Operating Plug, money missing? Input a false number, submit balanced budget.

Linda Woodford's Eraser, money missing every month; fifteen years falsifying Navy records.

Same eraser, abroad: The Iraq Pocket Change, fifty billion wasted, six billion completely lost in Iraq.

The Ultimate Heist, scams, fraud, destroyed evidence; eight point five trillion to investigate.

So who checks? The Suspects' Story, the answers are not going to come from the suspects of the crime.

Papers, please: The Destroyed Records, CBOE to Convar, the money trail always disappears into the ether.

Uncle FrizzleBob's Verdict, changed everything? Right: it made the house infinitely rich.

Miss one receipt and the taxman writes. Miss eight point five trillion and Congress never holds a single hearing. Guess who pays for both.

Stay Fluffy, Folks!
